description: This file defines interfaces, constants, and function prototypes for the xdiff functionality, which involves computing differences between files, handling diffs, and related configurations. It includes type definitions for callback functions related to diff output, as well as function declarations for reading files, comparing lines, hashing strings, and managing diff configurations.

methods.name: xdi_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff operation between two memory-mapped files with given options, producing output via callbacks.

methods.name: xdi_diff_outf
methods.description: Performs a diff operation between two memory-mapped files, outputting diff hunks and lines using provided callback functions.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a mmfile_t structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads a blob object identified by an object ID into a mmfile_t structure.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets a function to find specific patterns in diff output based on configuration.

methods.name: xdiff_clear_find_func
methods.description: Clears any find function set for diff output.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses a string to determine conflict style configuration.

methods.name: git_xmerge_config
methods.description: Configures merge options in Git related to xdiff functionalities.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two lines of text with optional whitespace handling flags.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a string with whitespace handling options.

ctags.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(void * data,long old_begin,long old_nr,long new_begin,long new_nr,const char * func,long funclen)
